corrections.class: stale prose inside a frozen artefact (FINDING 177 class)
corrections.must_not_conclude: That any uk cell in v1.1 is pinned to a 2015 EPW. No field of any of the 510 cells says so; only this caveat prose does, and it is wrong.
corrections.statement: The C-19 amendment block of v1.1 names uk_london_2014_2015_y2015.epw among the three pinned weather files. That sentence was inherited verbatim from v1.0 and is SUPERSEDED by D-S10-7: in v1.1 the 180 uk cells and the weather.uk block all read uk_london_2014_2015_y2014.epw, sha256 7b7d9524d6667d79572a3453b7ece531a6b2717dd496aaa239ec925fbce6e295.

reason: The v1.1 digest above is filed on both the OpenUBEM and the GSSCanada 4J side. Amending the spec in place would invalidate it, so a prose-only correction is carried here instead of in a v1.2.
unaffected: revision_note.previous_uk_epw_path and revision_note.change name the y2015 file deliberately, as the superseded pin. Those are correct and are not corrections.
